output_or_check: Optional isolated_streams diagnostics; not modeled as standalone subbasins

processing_action: Convert km→m; compute drop from smoothed elevations (cm→m scaling)
output_or_check: ChannelLenM; drop fields retained through merges

Walk upstream from each terminal reach
output_or_check: Subbasin_level_1 index grouped with HUC12 later

output_or_check: Final subbasin index used for dissolves
notes: Counts vary by basin—use Tab-ModelComplexity not this table.

processing_action: Area threshold 0.1 km2; map FType to SWAT+ classes; harmonize adjacent lakes; renumber lake/channel IDs from 1

purpose: Reduce fragment subbasins toward typical HUC12 scale
input_fields_or_layers: Subbasin polygons; A_min=62.5 km2 (~75% mean Michigan HUC12)
processing_action: Single-pass merge of subbasins < A_min into immediate downstream subbasin when in-domain downstream exists; terminal subbasins between A_min/5 and A_min retained; isolated units < A_min/5 flagged/connected
notes: Not iterative to A_min; separate ~0.01 km2 QSWAT guard follows in same pass.

purpose: Export integrity before handoff to QSWAT+
processing_action: Check 1:1 stream–catchment; one subbasin per reach; acyclic main routing; unique IDs from 1; lake outlets resolved or logged
output_or_check: Pass/fail logs and sidecar stats JSON where enabled
notes: Pass/fail rates are needs_metric until logs are summarized.
